remarks: Fully remodeled condo in downtown Stamford. Located on the 5th floor, this unit offers vaulted ceilings, abundant natural light, and a bright open concept layout. The brand new kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a large island with seating, opening directly into the main living space. Both bathrooms have been fully remodeled with clean, modern finishes. This 2 bedroom, 2 bath layout includes hardwood floors throughout main areas and new carpet in the bedrooms. Private balcony overlooking a professionally landscaped courtyard. Garage parking included. Full service building with concierge and fitness center. Just minutes to Metro North, restaurants, shopping, and everything downtown Stamford has to offer. Ideal for primary residence or investment with strong rental appeal. Completely move in ready, fully remodeled units with this level of finish are rarely available in this building.
